summary: All 81 requirements implemented in two controllers (gas analysis, movement), 18 files. Nothing unimplemented; the issues below are defaults and choices the requirements did not settle.

issues.title: Values of the six configuration constants
issues.raw: CD-Const1..6 name thr, lv, evadeTime, stuckPeriod, stuckDist, outPeriod but give no values.
issues.fix_directive: THR=2.0, LV=1.0, EVADE_TIME=1, STUCK_PERIOD=3, STUCK_DIST=1.0, OUT_PERIOD=2. Small and integer-valued, so the model's constant rounding does not change them; STUCK_PERIOD > EVADE_TIME so both outcomes of AvoidingAgain are reachable. Replace with deployment values.

issues.title: Sensing direction of each reading position (angle(x))
issues.raw: CD-Fn3 uses angle(x) and CD-DM7 says the 1-based position maps to a sensing direction, but the mapping is not given.
issues.fix_directive: Position 1 -> Front, 2 -> Right, 3 -> Back, 4 -> Left, repeating; on a tie the first position wins.

issues.title: intensity and location on an empty reading
issues.raw: CD-Fn2 and CD-Fn3 have the precondition 'non-empty'; Java functions must return something.
issues.fix_directive: Empty reading: intensity 0.0, location Front. Unreachable from GasDetected, since gasD implies a non-empty reading.

issues.title: Initial values of state variables
issues.raw: Only gs has a stated initial value (empty).
issues.fix_directive: sts=noGas, ins=0.0, anl=Front, a=Front, l=front, d0=d1=0.0, evasion clock start=0. Each is written before it is read on every path.

issues.title: What 'indicates the target chemical' means, and which chemical is the target
issues.raw: CD-Fn1: noGas 'if no reading indicates the target chemical'. No requirement names the target chemical.
issues.fix_directive: The target Chem is given to GasSensorArray at startup; a value indicates it when c equals the target and i > 0.

issues.title: Final states as terminal modes
issues.raw: CD-GA-Beh6 ends gas analysis in a final state not listed among its states; CD-MV-Beh9 keeps Movement halted in Found.
issues.fix_directive: Gas analysis gets a terminal mode CONCLUDED; Movement's FOUND is terminal. Neither has outgoing transitions.

issues.title: Waiting's during action randomWalk() issued on entry
issues.raw: CD-MV-FR1: 'The during action is randomWalk()'. The Java profile has no during construct.
issues.fix_directive: randomWalk() is issued on every entry to WAITING (each resume branch) and, for the initial entry, in the constructor. The walk is unbounded until superseded, so starting it on entry has the same effect.

issues.title: Platform operations as Vehicle actuator methods, not operation classes
issues.raw: CD-OP1..4 are of type operation; the profile's operation class has a parameterless compute() of assignments that returns results through getters.
issues.fix_directive: move(lv, a), randomWalk(), shortRandomWalk() and changeDirection(l) are parameterised commands with no result, so they are methods of VehicleActuator, called in the entry actions. changeDirection maps left->Right, right->Left, front->Back at LV.

issues.title: Odometer as a sensor read
issues.raw: CD-Evt3 is typed event, but the movement subsystem only samples the distance (into d0 or d1); it never triggers a transition.
issues.fix_directive: OdometerSensor.odometer() is read in the Avoiding entry (d0) and on TryingAgain -> AvoidingAgain (d1).

issues.title: Names and representations
issues.raw: State 'Analysis' and function 'analysis' differ only in case; Intensity and Chem are abstract types.
issues.fix_directive: Analysis state is mode ANALYSING. Intensity is real (double), ordered by goreq. Chem is a record with a nat species id, compared by equality.

issues.title: Delivery of turn/stop/resume between the two controllers
issues.raw: CD-ARCH2: the reasoning subsystems communicate only via turn, stop and resume.
issues.fix_directive: Gas analysis sends them through AnalysisActuator (OutputEvent.Turn/Stop/Resume); Movement receives InputEvent.Turn/Stop/Resume. No Java wiring class forwards one to the other: delivery is left to the deployment harness, and in the model the module connects the shared events.

next_step: Run the pipeline; revisit these choices only if a phase or the operator objects.
